# Open Learning Atlas Agent Guide

Open Learning Atlas is an open, versioned coordinate system for educational
knowledge and capability. Mathematics is the first domain. The canonical
artifact is a typed claim graph, not a curriculum, grade sequence, learner
model, assessment product, or tutoring application.

## Agent Boot Sequence

1. Read [`methodology/map-constitution.md`](methodology/map-constitution.md)
   before changing semantics.
2. Read [`architecture/map-data-model.md`](architecture/map-data-model.md)
   before creating records.
3. Validate candidate documents against
   [`map/schema/open-learning-atlas.schema.json`](map/schema/open-learning-atlas.schema.json).
4. Run [`tools/validate-map`](tools/validate-map) after any map edit.
5. Treat every AI-authored node or claim as `candidate`; an agent may not
   promote its own work.

## Current Canonical Artifacts

- [`map/domains/mathematics-macro-v0.1.json`](map/domains/mathematics-macro-v0.1.json)
  — 99 nodes and 115 navigational composition claims.
- [`map/examples/rational-proportional-v0.1.json`](map/examples/rational-proportional-v0.1.json)
  — 18 typed nodes, 25 edge claims, and one alternative-method requirement group.
- [`map/domains/mathematics-topology.md`](map/domains/mathematics-topology.md)
  — human-readable macro view.
- [`docs/v1-completion-contract.md`](docs/v1-completion-contract.md) — the
  measurable end-state contract.
- [`docs/human-agent-access.md`](docs/human-agent-access.md) — parity rules for
  human and machine access.

## Identity and Direction

IDs use opaque UUIDs with type prefixes:

- `ola:m:<uuid>` — map document;
- `ola:n:<uuid>` — node;
- `ola:e:<uuid>` — relationship claim;
- `ola:r:<uuid>` — requirement group;
- `ola:s:<uuid>` — source.

Every edge reads `subject relation object`. Labels, slugs, paths, grades, and
taxonomy positions must never be encoded in IDs.

## Critical Semantics

- The map uses an open-world assumption: absent means “not mapped,” not false.
- `composed_of` expresses coverage or component membership, never learning order.
- `requires` is reserved for scoped necessity between assessable nodes.
- Alternative sufficient methods belong in `any-of` or `at-least` requirement
  groups, not multiple universal prerequisites.
- Concepts, knowledge, representations, and composites are not independently
  assessable. Capabilities and practices are.
- AI proposals must carry provenance, rationale, confidence, and review state.

## Machine Use

Do not scrape the future visual site. Consume a pinned JSON release or the
canonical JSON documents directly. Preserve IDs and revisions when caching.
Filter by record status and confidence explicitly; never silently treat
`candidate` as `accepted`.

## Current Development State

The v0.1 constitution is ratified and the macro atlas validates. Most
mathematical terrain is still represented only by broad composites. The main
work toward v1 is consistent decomposition into concepts, representations,
knowledge, practices, and bounded observable capabilities across every region,
followed by a generated mobile viewer and versioned public releases.

External sources retain their own rights and are cited for provenance; source
references do not import third-party content into the atlas.
